mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below its 12-month moving average, it compresses the risk-free rate, increasing equity present value and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 12mo MA

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, restrictive monetary policy compresses equity valuation multiples, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 3.0% and core CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% annually, restrictive real rates reduce equity valuation multiples, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS>3.0% AND CPIAUCSL>2.5%

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed its 12-month moving average, robust residential demand supports consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 12mo MA

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 12-month moving average, manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 12mo MA

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) exceed their 12-month moving averages, strong housing demand supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST>12mo MA AND RSAFS>12mo MA

mechanism_narrative: When core CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% annually, high inflation triggers monetary tightening expectations, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5%
